english.title: Without authority possess inside a prison an item specified in section 40D(3B)
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without authority possessed inside a prison, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PRISON..),

(A)_[a device capable of transmitting or receiving images, sounds or information by electronic communications,]_
(B)_[a component part of a device capable of transmitting or receiving images, sounds or information by electronic communications,]_
(C)_[an article designed or adapted for use with a device capable of transmitting or receiving images, sounds or information by electronic communications,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE DEVICE / COMPONENT / ARTICLE..), being an item specified in section 40D(3B) of the Prison Act 1952
english.legislation: Contrary to section 40D(3A) and (5) of the Prison Act 1952.

english.notes:
(i) "Electronic communications" includes a mobile telephone.
(ii) "Article" includes any disk, film or other separate article on which images, sounds or information may be recorded.
(iii) This offence was inserted by section 45 of the Crime and Security Act 2010 with effect from 26/03/2012.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2022; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see paragraph 5 of Schedule 4 to the Offender Management Act 2007 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
